hints.title: Handle Small Base Cases
hints.text: If n is 0 return 0, and if n is 1 return 1.

hints.title: Simulate Array Generation
hints.text: Create an array of size n + 1 with nums[0] = 0 and nums[1] = 1, then apply the recurrence relations.

hints.title: Track Maximum Value
hints.text: As nums[2 * i] and nums[2 * i + 1] are filled, maintain the maximum value encountered.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive evaluation of recurrence rules repeats subproblems exponentially without memoization.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterative array generation takes O(n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle boundary condition n = 0 properly and avoid out-of-bounds indices.
